name: ArenaTimelineItem
description: One milestone of an ArenaTimeline: a stage one thing passes through. Whether it is complete, current or upcoming is not a field: the timeline derives it from its `index`. Arena draws every field, and a consumer places no markup inside a row.

id.description: A stable identity for the row, so a list that changes does not re-key by position.

title.description: The milestone, in the heading ink.

description.description: One or two sentences under the title, in the body ink.

time.description: When, preformatted, in the muted mono ink. ArenaTimeline never formats.

dateTime.description: The same moment as an ISO 8601 string. Present, Arena wraps the time's text in a real <time datetime>; with no `time`, nothing is drawn. Two fields, because `time` may be 3 min ago, which no parser resolves to a date.

tone.description: The milestone's meaning, which is not its progress: a complete milestone can be danger. A toned dot carries the tone's glyph, so the tone is never colour alone; neutral draws a plain dot. Tone is not spoken: the title says what happened.

icon.description: A Phosphor class name drawn in the dot in place of the tone's glyph.
